hooks.command:
input=$(cat); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; hook=$root/scripts/hooks/before-tool; [ -x "$hook" ] || exit 0; { reason=$(printf '%s
' "$input" | "$hook" 2>&1 >&3); } 3>&1; hook_status=$?; [ -z "$reason" ] || printf '%s
' "$reason" >&2; [ $hook_status -eq 2 ] || exit $hook_status; main=$(git -C "$root" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1s/^worktree //p'); main_hook=$main/scripts/hooks/before-tool; [ -n "$main" ] && [ -x "$main_hook" ] && [ ! "$main_hook" -ef "$hook" ] || exit 2; probe_reason=$(printf '%s
' '{"tool_name": "Bash", "tool_input": {"command": "true"}}' | "$hook" 2>&1 >/dev/null) && exit 2; [ "$probe_reason" = "$reason" ] || exit 2; note="$hook can't run, so the main checkout's copy checked this action instead."; printf '%s Fix the file that the error above names.
' "$note" >&2; printf '%s
' "$input" | "$main_hook" || exit $?; jq -n --arg note "$note Fix the file that this error names: $reason" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", additionalContext: $note}}'
